record.title: Select one bounded validation of the recovered AFE calibration contract
record.intent: Use static evidence to choose useful runtime falsification points instead of one experiment per software operation.
requirements: Evaluate the complete AFE loader pair against the actual333bac stock checkpoint and distinguish file reconstruction from mapped-register modeling. State the next externally unsatisfied dependency and all model assumptions.

Prefer one whole-subsystem prediction with precise entry/exit observations when supported. Do not split deterministic software writes or file-error paths into per-operation guest experiments. Retain mapped-access observation unless evidence establishes a concrete deficiency.

Draft a small successor preparation, qualified control and stock validation batch with an explicit decision task as needed; run plan, inspect mutation, admit against the expected revision and commit and push before execution. No new guest run or device response in this decision task.
acceptance: An evidence-supported bounded successor or precise limitation is committed and pushed.
